description:
Podpin helps you get more value from every podcast episode.

Listen in a focused player, follow along with AI-powered transcripts, highlight important moments, and save bookmarks so you can return to them later.

Use Podpin to:
- Listen to podcasts in a simple, fast player
- Read along with transcripts
- Save highlights and bookmarks
- Review episodes with chapters and insights
- Catch references and useful takeaways
- Search moments worth remembering

Podpin is built for learning, research, note-taking, and better listening.\n\nTerms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
promotionalText: Listen, read transcripts, save bookmarks, and get back to the most useful moments in every podcast episode.
whatsNew: Discover podcasts on the road with new CarPlay browsing and Siri support. Browse trending shows and categories, then confirm before following—nothing follows or plays automatically. Ask Siri to find a show or resume what is currently playing. Episode playback, sharing, mini-player reliability, and transcript-based pins are also improved.
